name: Nutrition Benefits Grid
description: Numbered nutrition principles for healthy cafés, coaches and food brands
css: .tb-food-benefits{padding:clamp(34px,6vw,80px);background:var(--tb-color-surface)}.tb-food-benefits__head{max-width:760px;margin-bottom:30px}.tb-food-benefits__eyebrow{color:var(--tb-color-primary);font-size:12px;font-weight:950;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.16em}.tb-food-benefits__title{margin:8px 0;color:var(--tb-color-secondary);font-size:clamp(40px,5vw,62px)}.tb-food-benefits__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);border-left:1px solid var(--tb-color-border)}.tb-food-benefits__item{padding:28px;border-right:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--tb-color-border)}.tb-food-benefits__num{display:block;color:var(--tb-color-primary);font-weight:950;font-size:13px}.tb-food-benefits__item h3{margin:28px 0 8px;color:var(--tb-color-secondary);font-size:26px}.tb-food-benefits__item p{margin:0;color:var(--tb-color-muted);line-height:1.65}@media(max-width:620px){.tb-food-benefits__grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
